test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Whose autobiography is titled 'Born Again on the Mountain : a story of losing everything and finding it back'?
solution:
The correct answer is **Arunima Sinha**.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arunima Sinha** is the author of the autobiography titled 'Born Again on the Mountain: A Story of Losing Everything and Finding It Back'*.
 
• She is a former Indian national volleyball player and a mountaineer.
 
• Arunima Sinha is the first female amputee to climb Mount Everest.
 
• Her autobiography details her journey of overcoming adversity after losing her leg in a tragic accident and achieving her dream of climbing Everest.
